Hi Sara — thanks for sending this over. I received the W-9 and will start the onboarding queue. A few items for clarity so we can get a PO issued without back-and-forth: 

1) Legal name vs DBA: On the W-9 the "Name" listed is "Ventra Health" but the EIN registration we see sometimes references "Ventra Health Solutions, LLC". If you could confirm the exact legal entity associated with EIN 12-3456789 that saves time.

2) ACH/bank proof: We typically require one of the following for ACH enablement — a bank letter on bank letterhead, a voided check, or a bank confirmation PDF. A bank letter is preferred for faster verification.

3) For faster routing to Finance: can you include the AP contact (full name & phone) on the next message and confirm billing address?

Jordan (procurement) / Rishi (finance), looping you in — vendor submitted the W-9; I'm flagging a potential nominal name mismatch between W-9 and TIN registry. Please advise whether we should request the IRS CP575/EIN confirmation or accept a signed attestation + bank letter. Also note: we prefer PO issuance to be blocked until TIN/name clears.

Sara — if you can send the bank letter and a short note confirming the legal entity name, I can move you to the top of the queue. Targeting PO issuance within 48 hours after verification.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
